title: HUD STATES ON THE VITALS
why: his ask 10-27 ~21:40: the hud messaging is a clusterfuck, make it AAA (report reports/Player alerts and HUD messaging.md, job 5). Revealed, concealed and in cover are small icons beside the stance chip bottom left for as long as they are true (each word shows for 2 s the first time), and the hidden pill leaves the mid left column. Under a quarter health the hp bar pulses slowly, 1.2 a second, with no text. Low ammo pulses the count red; an empty gun with rounds to load shows the reload key cap on the gun card. Looting, the pickup stack and the money rows are untouched.
now: revealed, hidden and in cover are small icons by your stance; low health pulses the bar; low ammo pulses the count; an empty gun shows the reload key
